subject: Social Media
title: Twitter's 140 Characters
description: A fast breakdown of Twitter's 140 Characters for builders.

hook.text: Twitter launched in 2006 with a 140-character limit. That constraint made it fast, punchy, and addictive.

buildup.text: The limit came from SMS: 160 chars minus 20 for a username. A technical limitation that became culture.

discovery.text: Brevity forced wit. Political debate, breaking news, jokes—all compressed. Twitter became the public square.

twist.text: They doubled it to 280 in 2017. Critics said it'd kill the culture. It survived. Habits stuck anyway.

climax.text: Twitter proved a constraint could build culture. The format shaped thought, not just expression.

punchline.text: 140 characters changed how the world thinks.

quiz.question: Why was Twitter's original limit 140 characters?
